question: Where can I get a list of drinking water treatment plants in Spain, with location, capacity and operator?

answer.summary: No public national list of drinking water treatment plants (ETAP) with location, capacity and operator exists. The national registry (SINAC, 2,625 ETAP in 2024) is restricted to professional users. Public pieces: EIEL (rows per treatment, not plant, small municipalities, no name or capacity), Andalucía DERA WFS (870 points) and Madrid WFS (14 plants with capacity, Canal de Isabel II), Navarra (2 plants), plus operator pages (MCT, Aigües de Barcelona).
main_caveats: EIEL rows are potabilization treatments, not plants: in Asturias 2024, 1,106 of 1,111 rows are disinfection-only; ORGANISMO is the quality-control body, not the operator.
EIEL excludes municipalities of 50,000 or more and País Vasco and Navarra; in the 2024 download only 15 of 52 provinces have rows.
Capacity units differ or are missing (Madrid NM_CAPACIDAD is m3/day by inference, Navarra none, MCT m³/seg, Aigües de Barcelona l/s).
The Andalucía layer named ETAP includes 364 deposits and 333 chlorination points among 870 features; last update 2022-02-02.
Catalonia (more than 250 ETAP, three operators), Valencia, Galicia, Canarias and País Vasco have no ETAP layer found; regional portals were not each opened.
answer.confidence_reason: Negatives rest on opened ministry, IDE and open-data pages; SINAC content is unseen, OSM operator counts failed and several regional portals were only probed by catalogue search.

attributes.note: Points for Andalucía, Madrid, Navarra, Pontevedra, Badajoz, EIEL where the layer has them, and OSM; Catalonia, Valencia, Galicia, País Vasco: none found.
attributes.gap_note: No ETAP layer found for the other regions in IDEE CODSI, datos.gob.es titles, ACA/Catalan open data and web searches; region portals not each opened (see leads).

attributes.note: Madrid 14 plants, Navarra 2 (no unit), MCT 3 of 6, Aigües de Barcelona 3 in prose. EIEL, DERA and SINAC public pages have none.
attributes.gap_note: No capacity in EIEL dictionary, DERA layer, SINAC public pages or annual report; other operators' pages not all opened.

attributes.note: Madrid (Canal de Isabel II, from metadata), Navarra TITULAR, MCT and Aigües de Barcelona; EIEL gives only the control body; Catalonia names 3 operators.
attributes.gap_note: SINAC holds the operator per infrastructure but only for professional users; no public per-plant operator list elsewhere.

problems: The ministry sede pages sede.administracionespublicas.gob.es/ayuda/consulta/EIEL and /EIELDescargas returned HTTP 503 (Ha ocurrido un error, vuelva a intentarlo más tarde) on three tries; eiel.redsara.es works.
The viewer shapefile export is corrupt (all points at 1,0).

example.example_request: curl -sL -G 'https://eiel.redsara.es/descargas/descargar-fichero' --data-urlencode 'periodo=2024' --data-urlencode 'cuadro=Todos los cuadros' --data-urlencode 'provincia=41' --data-urlencode 'isla=Seleccionar' --data-urlencode 'municipio=Seleccionar' --data-urlencode 'nivel=P' -o 2024_41.zip ; for points: curl -sL 'https://eiel.redsara.es/visor/layer-json/fase:2024-codine:33/capa:TP'
